newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April chain store sales down 4.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan April chain store sales down 4.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at chain stores in Japan in April declined 4.6 percent from a year earlier to 1.33 trillion yen, the Japan Chain Stores Association said on Monday.
Month-on-month, chain stores posted a 13.0 percent decrease in sales in April, the association said in a statement.
The decrease was due to lower sales after a surge in demand in March ahead of the April 1 increase in Japan's national sales tax, it said.
Items such as furniture and electrical appliances were the most affected, it added.
The survey covered 7,835 outlets of 130 companies.
The sales tax rose to five percent on April 1 from three percent previously.
